author: J. C. Kemp
title: Summit Learning Program mathematics MCA tested exclusively 11th-graders in 2024-25
text:
The Minnesota Department of Education reported that at Summit Learning Program, only 11th-graders took the mathematics portion of the 2024-25 MCA.
Five 11th-grade students from Summit Learning Program participated in this part of the assessment.
This was an increase from the prior school year, when four 11th-grade students completed the mathematics MCAs.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are Minnesota’s statewide tests that track student progress toward state academic standards and fulfill legislative requirements. Math, reading and science are tested based on student grade level. While most students take the MCA, those receiving special education services who meet certain criteria are eligible for the Alt MCA.
Based on Minnesota’s Report Card , overall proficiency in Minnesota MCA exams has dropped below pre-pandemic rates. Math proficiency declined by over 7% compared to 2019, with reading proficiency also down nearly 5%.
This article includes information from the Minnesota Department of Education. The original data may be reviewed here .
